name: accordion
purpose: A vertically stacked set of disclosure items: each item has a clickable header that expands or collapses its content panel. Use it to condense long content into scannable sections. Unlike `tabs` (mutually-exclusive panels shown in place), an accordion can keep one item open at a time (`type="single"`) or several at once (`type="multiple"`), and its content expands inline below each header.
useWhen: Long content splits into independent sections the reader scans by heading and opens on demand (settings groups, help topics, a details list).
The reader may want one section open at a time (`type="single"`) or to compare several side by side (`type="multiple"`).
Content should expand inline below its heading, pushing the rest of the page down.
avoidWhen: The panels are mutually exclusive views shown in the same place → use `tabs`.
It is the frequently-asked-questions band of a marketing page → use `faq-section` (or `faq` for the band without the page-section wiring).
It is hierarchical navigation with expandable rows → use `menu`.
related: tabs` — switches between panels in place; one panel visible, headers in a row.
faq` — the marketing FAQ band that composes `accordion` with a heading column and hairline register.
menu` — expanding rows for navigation, not for revealing content.
bestPractices: Give every `Accordion.Item` a unique `value`; the open state is keyed by it, and `default-value` / `v-model` refer to it.
Bind `v-model` to a string in `type="single"` and to an array in `type="multiple"`; set `collapsible` to `false` only when one item must always stay open.
Set the trigger's `level` to fit the page outline (default `3`) — each trigger is wrapped in a real heading.
Accordion.Content` applies no padding; pad the content you put inside it.
Set `size` and `arrow-position` on the root, not per item — they are provided to every item through context.

props.name: type
props.doc: Whether one or multiple items can be open at the same time.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: In single mode, lets the open item collapse so that no item is open.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects header height, padding, and typography. Provided to every item via context.

props.name: arrowPosition
props.doc: Side of the header the chevron sits on. Provided to every item via context.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The `Accordion.Item` children. Each sub-component's own `default` slot is documented in the Sub-components section.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Accordion from '@aziontech/webkit/accordion'
</script>

<template>
  <Accordion
    type="single"
    collapsible
    default-value="overview"
    size="medium"
    arrow-position="right"
    class="w-full max-w-[40rem]"
  >
    <Accordion.Item value="overview">
      <Accordion.Trigger>What is Azion?</Accordion.Trigger>
      <Accordion.Content>Azion runs your code at the edge, close to users.</Accordion.Content>
    </Accordion.Item>
    <Accordion.Item value="pricing">
      <Accordion.Trigger>How does pricing work?</Accordion.Trigger>
      <Accordion.Content>Pay only for what you use, with no upfront cost.</Accordion.Content>
    </Accordion.Item>
    <Accordion.Item value="support">
      <Accordion.Trigger>Enterprise support</Accordion.Trigger>
      <Accordion.Content>Available on Business and Enterprise plans.</Accordion.Content>
    </Accordion.Item>
  </Accordion>
</template>
